golden_theme_contract.first_principles_rule: Before submitting or scoring any new carousel idea, use these source files as the first-principles explanation of why the gold carousel worked: universal anti-ideal -> concrete Aachu proof -> Zuv steady response -> tender acceptance thesis.
golden_theme_contract.rule: Every carousel must start from a universal relationship truth, then prove it through Aachu/Zuv specifics. Photos, places, outfits, and objects are evidence, not the premise.
hard_fail_if: The concept is primarily about an object, outfit, location, or photo aesthetic.
A stranger could not send the carousel to a partner without knowing the private photo context.
Aachu's expressive role is missing or mocked.
Zuv's calm role is passive, absent, or treated as background.
The concept is mostly about taking photos, looking beautiful, glowing, or waiting for one more picture without a deeper relationship tension.
One partner's role is only looking good while the other waits or holds things.
The final thesis is generic romance without a concrete proof trail.
default_five_slide_map: Universal hook: one swipe-stopping relationship truth.
Aachu-specific reveal: her version of the truth.
Concrete proof: a drawable behavior, object, or ritual from the reference material.
Zuv role: what his calm, patience, care, or choice does emotionally.
Save/share thesis: the tender truth underneath the joke.
caption_formula: Open with the universal relationship truth.
Show the couple-specific behavior, care, posture, object, or rhythm in the middle; name Aachu/Zuv only when natural.
End with a soft send/save-worthy thesis.

visual_style: Create a complete publishable @a.storyof.two social slide in the established Aachu/Zuv illustrated carousel look: soft hand-drawn flat vector warmth with desi storybook texture. Treat the first supplied style references as canonical character-model sheets: preserve the same recurring illustrated character faces, proportions, hair shapes, expressive eyes, beard/brow structure, handwritten lettering, warm paper texture, and soft desi storybook linework from the accepted earlier carousels. Use Product Unshipped-like simplicity adapted for a desi love story, but do not reinterpret the couple into a new generic illustration style. Use the provided identity and style references to create recurring illustrated versions of Aachu/Anchal and Zuv/Himanshu, not generic stock characters. Keep warm off-white paper, imperfect black outlines, slightly uneven strokes, matte muted colors, generous breathing room, expressive faces, detailed-but-soft Indian outfits when story-relevant, and one clear Aachu/Zuv behavior scene. Every final prompt must stay scene-first: paper artifacts, receipts, labels, posters, or stationery can appear only as tiny integrated details, never as the main visual system. Minimalism must still feel alive: keep a few tiny innocent micro-elements such as small hearts, blush marks, reaction ticks, tiny motion lines, soft thought/reaction bubbles, or one small care detail when they support the emotional beat. Render the exact slide copy as handwritten-style black text inside the artwork, and add the tiny low-contrast handwritten brandmark '@a.storyof.two' at bottom-right as part of the generated image.
